exposure: various phenotypes of endometriosis (stages and locations)
cohort: Women from the FinnGen, OpenGWAS, and ReproGen consortia, whose genetic data and reproductive outcomes were analyzed.
finding: Mendelian randomization analysis revealed that moderate to severe endometriosis and ovarian endometriosis negatively affect age at last live birth and normal delivery, fallopian tubal endometriosis negatively affects excessive irregular menstruation, and age at menarche has a negative causal effect on intestinal endometriosis.
mod_finding: Moderate to severe endometriosis and ovarian endometriosis were found to have a negative causal effect on normal delivery.
